# Baez Studio

> Baez Studio (BAEZ.AI.STUDIO) is a boutique studio led by Josh Baez, a creative producer and performance video editor with 15+ years of commercial post-production since 2008. It sells two services: cinematic AI video production (brand films, brand revivals, lore and game cinematics, paid-social Hook Packs, Remotion programmatic video; from $1,500 per project) and custom AI business stacks (custom ChatGPT/Gemini/Claude workflows connecting Google Sheets, CRM, email, newsletters, branded flyers and social publishing; audit $750–$1,500, builds $2,500–$18,000). Clients own 100% of deliverables and workflows. Based in Ann Arbor, MI and Fort Wayne, IN; serves clients worldwide. Contact: josh@baez.studio.

## Services

- [Cinematic AI Video Production](https://baez.studio/video-production/): formats, process, before/after, pricing and FAQ
- [Custom AI Business Stacks](https://baez.studio/ai-business-stacks/): workflow architecture, ROI example, data security, pricing and FAQ
- [Pricing overview](https://baez.studio/#pricing): video packages, AI stack packages and the Hybrid Growth Retainer
